sbomBinding.meaning: SBOM REFERENCES AND DIGESTS MUST BELONG TO THE SAME RELEASE CANDIDATE ARTIFACT

attestation.verifiedMeaning: ATTESTATION EVIDENCE BINDS THE REVIEWED ARTIFACT DIGEST TO THE REVIEWED SOURCE COMMIT AND BUILD

failClosedRules: The current required check named Release provenance gate is repository policy evidence only and is not a cryptographic provenance or attestation by itself.
GitHub Actions artifact upload is transport/storage evidence and is not release signing authority.
A branch name, pull-request number, mutable URL or tag without an immutable artifact digest is not artifact identity.
Production promotion remains HOLD until the artifact digest, source commit, build evidence and both SBOM digests are present and reviewed.
Production promotion remains HOLD while attestation status is UNVERIFIED.
Production promotion remains HOLD while signingAuthority.state is UNSELECTED or signingAuthorityRef is missing.
A VERIFIED attestation must bind the same artifact SHA-256, source commit SHA and build run reference recorded by the release candidate.
Private signing keys, tokens, credentials and secret values must never be stored in repository release receipts or logs.
This contract selects no signing mechanism, signing provider, key custody system, builder platform or production artifact registry.
